adapters.name: meeting_note
adapters.description: Meeting minutes: decisions taken, risks raised and attendees.
adapters.integration_note: Accepts a documented JSON record (file upload, webhook payload or API call). No live provider credential or connector is configured in this build.

input_shape.title: required - meeting title
input_shape.author: optional - who wrote the notes (recorded as the author)
input_shape.participants: optional - attendees; recorded as weaker evidence than authorship
input_shape.actions: optional - action items, preserved as metadata

adapters.name: prd
adapters.description: A product requirements document describing scope, decisions and dependencies.
adapters.integration_note: Accepts a documented JSON record (file upload, webhook payload or API call). No live provider credential or connector is configured in this build.

input_shape.title: required - the document title
input_shape.sections: optional - list of {heading, body} objects, preserved as metadata
input_shape.author: optional - document owner

adapters.name: slack
adapters.description: A Slack message: channel conversation, alert or announcement.
adapters.integration_note: Accepts a documented JSON record (file upload, webhook payload or API call). No live provider credential or connector is configured in this build.

input_shape.external_id: required - the provider message id (used for de-duplication)
input_shape.author: optional - display name or handle of the sender
input_shape.title: optional - short summary; defaults to a truncation of the body
input_shape.mentions: optional - list of entity names the message discusses
input_shape.thread_id: optional - thread parent id, preserved as metadata

adapters.name: ticket
adapters.description: A support, incident or engineering ticket with a resolver.
adapters.integration_note: Accepts a documented JSON record (file upload, webhook payload or API call). No live provider credential or connector is configured in this build.

input_shape.resolved_by: optional - who closed it (recorded as the RESOLVED edge)
input_shape.mentions: optional - list of entity names the ticket concerns
